approved.en: Ukraine has continued to use naval drones to strike Russian warships at Libya’s Benghazi port, prompting Zelensky to say Ukraine can attack wherever it wants. Russian forces have violated Finnish airspace with a helicopter and Polish airspace with an unmanned aerial vehicle, while Russia is reportedly preparing to place a nuclear weapon in space within 60 days, according to a German warning. The UN reports that civilian casualties in Ukraine in 2026 already far exceed previous years, and Zelensky has called for four-way peace talks with Russia, Europe and the US. Battle-related deaths totaled 75,767 in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Ukraina har fortsatt brukt sjø-droner til å angripe russiske krigsskip i Libyas havn Benghazi, noe som fikk Zelensky til å si at Ukraina kan angripe hvor det vil. Russiske styrker har krenket finsk luftrom med en helikopter og polsk luftrom med et ubemannet luftfartøy, mens Russland angivelig forbereder å plassere et atomvåpen i verdensrommet innen 60 dager, ifølge en tysk advarsel. FN melder at sivile tap i Ukraina i 2026 allerede langt overgår tidligere år, og Zelensky har oppfordret til fireveis fredsforhandlinger med Russland, Europa og USA. Dødsfall knyttet til kamper beløp seg til 75 767 i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Israeli forces continue strikes in Gaza, killing a UNRWA worker and others, while also cutting off vital hearing-aid supplies and approving sewage pumps that will discharge raw waste into the Mediterranean, worsening environmental damage described as a toxic wasteland. In the West Bank, Israeli checkpoints impede ambulance drivers and have become dangerous obstacles, and Israeli raids on refugee camps have led to dozens of detentions. Israeli incursions into southern Syria have triggered fear and destruction, extending the conflict beyond Gaza and the West Bank. The conflict has caused 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

På Vestbredden hindrer israelske kontrollposter ambulanseførere og har blitt farlige hindringer, og israelske raid på flyktningleirer har ført til dusinvis av pågripelser. Israelske inntrengninger i sørlige Syria har utløst frykt og ødeleggelse, og utvidet konflikten utover Gaza og Vestbredden. Konflikten har forårsaket 21 440 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Israeli forces demolished houses in southern Lebanon, withdrew and allowed villagers to return to damaged homes while Lebanese President Aoun warned Israel to pull back and cautioned Iran against interference. An IDF spokesperson visited a Lebanese school, sparking outrage and prompting an analyst to warn the move could push Lebanese Christians toward Hezbollah. Israel publicly sent best wishes to Lebanon on its Independence Day, which was observed quietly amid muted celebrations and ongoing drone activity over Beirut and strikes on southern Lebanese towns. The conflict has caused 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

En talsperson fra IDF besøkte en libanesisk skole, noe som vekket oppsikt og fikk en analytiker til å advare om at handlingen kan drive libanesiske kristne mot Hizbollah. Israel sendte offentlige beste ønsker til Libanon på landets uavhengighetsdag, som ble markert stille med dempede feiringer og pågående droneaktivitet over Beirut og angrep på sørlige libanesiske byer. Konflikten har forårsaket 4 335 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

Saudi-led coalition forces also intercepted a Houthi drone and a missile in western Yemen and struck a Houthi arms depot east of Taiz. The conflict continues to cause high civilian casualties, including dozens of children killed, and 918 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.

Den saudisk-ledede koalisjonsstyrken avskjærte også en houthi-drone og et missil i vestlige Jemen og slo ned et houthi-våpenlager øst for Taiz. Konflikten fører fortsatt til mange sivile tap, inkludert dusinvis av barn som er drept, og 918 dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

RSF ground forces attacked aid offices in Nyala and a shelter in West Kordofan, causing civilian casualties, and charity kitchens in Khartoum are closing, leaving displaced Sudanese, especially the elderly, in severe hardship. Sudanese doctors are urging aid agencies to rehabilitate a looted hospital in West Kordofan, and the Sennar state has resumed banana exports to Saudi Arabia after a multi-year halt. The conflict produced 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

RSF-bakkestyrker angrep hjelpekontorer i Nyala og et tilfluktssted i Vest-Kordofan, noe som førte til sivile tap, og veldedige kjøkken i Khartoum stenger, noe som etterlater fortrengte sudanere, særlig eldre, i alvorlig nød. Sudanske leger oppfordrer hjelpeorganisasjoner til å rehabilitere et plyndret sykehus i Vest-Kordofan, og delstaten Sennar har gjenopptatt bananeksporten til Saudi-Arabia etter et flerårig stopp. Konflikten førte til 4 680 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Rebel and SPLA-IO forces have intensified attacks across South Sudan, killing civilians in Tonj East, Warrap State, and other locations, with recent incidents reporting 24 deaths including children and women. Cattle-theft raids have also turned lethal, leaving dozens dead and prompting fear of missing persons after assaults on islands such as Miny Island in Jonglei. The violence has spread to the political sphere, with the brother of former Juba Mayor James Allah-Jabu dying and the former vice president Igga announcing the death. The crisis now includes large-scale killings reported in Ruweng and ongoing insecurity ahead of the postponed 2026 election. According to UCDP, there were 2 battle-related deaths in 2024.
approved.nb: Rebel- og SPLA-IO-styrker har økt angrepene over hele Sør-Sudan, og har drept sivile i Tonj East i Warrap-stat og andre steder, med nylige hendelser som rapporterer 24 døde, inkludert barn og kvinner. Kvegtyveri-raider har også blitt dødelige, og har etterlatt dusinvis av døde og skapt frykt for savnede etter angrep på øyer som Miny Island i Jonglei. Voldshandlingene har også nådd den politiske arenaen, da broren til den tidligere Juba-ordføreren James Allah-Jabu er død, og den tidligere visepresidenten Igga kunngjorde dødsfallet. Krisen omfatter nå store drap i Ruweng og vedvarende usikkerhet før det utsatte valget i 2026. Ifølge UCDP var det 2 dødsfall i kamper i 2024.

Nigeria, Cameroon, Chad and Niger have approved a 5 km cross-border military pursuit to combat terrorism, extending security operations beyond national borders. Ex-rebel fighters remain caught between hiding and broken promises, and activist Agbor Balla warned that a decade of bloodshed still prevents children from safely returning to school in the conflict zones. The conflict recorded 231 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Konflikten registrerte 231 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: The International Court of Justice has found Myanmar guilty of genocide against the Rohingya, prompting the General Assembly President to assure refugees they will not be alone and leading the UK to sanction top Myanmar military leaders. In May 2026 a Burma Army air strike in Doo Tha Htoo District killed one villager, injured five including two children, and destroyed houses in Bilin Township. The junta continues large-scale attacks on Rohingya civilians, destroying bridges in Arakan and extending a 108‑kilometre fence on the Bangladesh border, while admitting corruption in its conscription system and targeting nearly two hundred officials. There were 2,332 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

I mai 2026 drepte et luftangrep fra Burma-arméen i Doo Tha Htoo-distrikt en landsbyboer, såret fem, blant dem to barn, og ødela hus i Bilin kommune. Juntan fortsetter store angrep på rohingya-sivilbefolkningen, ødelegger broer i Arakan og utvider et 108‑kilometer langt gjerde på grensen mot Bangladesh, samtidig som den innrømmer korrupsjon i innkallingstjenesten og retter seg mot nesten to hundre tjenestemenn. Det var 2 332 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

The United States expanded military operations in Latin America, delivered a C-130 to Bogotá, and is being sued by Ecuadorian fishermen over a mysterious boat strike. The conflict recorded 225 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: US forces have begun a land operation against cartels inside Ecuador while expanding military activities across Latin America. Former presidential candidate has denounced prison conditions at an appeal hearing and prison gangs are now sending bills to families of inmates. President Noboa asked the United States for $430.5 billion in security aid, met with Pete Hegseth on anti-narco cooperation, and rejected claims that former vice president Jorge Glas was tortured, saying his injuries were self-inflicted. Ecuadorian journalist Omar Toledo, who denounced local corruption, was shot by motorcycle gunmen. The UCDP recorded 2 battle-related deaths in 2019, according to UCDP.

approved.en: The United States signed a military cooperation agreement with Venezuela's interim government and a U.S. marine died after falling overboard during a Caribbean operation linked to the renewed ties. Former oil minister Machado called for a more drastic overhaul of the oil sector amid hyperinflation, food shortages, massive emigration and socioeconomic collapse. Grassroots groups rejected the agreement as a normalization of subordination while military prisoners entered a third week without food and families took the fight to court. The U.S. Senate panel is investigating JD Vance's ties to a prized Venezuelan oil contract, and UCDP counted 2 battle-related deaths in 2007.
approved.nb: USA signerte en militær samarbeidsavtale med Venezuelas midlertidige regjering, og en amerikansk marine døde etter å ha falt overbord under en karibisk operasjon knyttet til de fornyede båndene. Den tidligere oljeministeren Machado oppfordret til en mer drastisk omlegging av oljesektoren midt i hyperinflasjon, matmangel, massiv emigrasjon og sosialøkonomisk kollaps. Grasrotgrupper avviste avtalen som en normalisering av underordning, mens militærfanger gikk inn i en tredje uke uten mat, og familier tok kampen til retten. Et USAs senatspanel etterforsker JD Vances bånd til en ettertraktet venezuelansk oljekontrakt, og UCDP registrerte 2 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2007.
